temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. He invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan sees Gary as a dedicated friend and doctor, but he has begun to suspect Gary's work habits are harming his health.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's refusal confirms that Gary is deeply absorbed in hospital obligations and is currently unwilling or unable to step away.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is seriously overworking due to hospital demands and is resistant to taking a break, so his concern is confirmed and increased.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and somewhat disappointed by Gary's refusal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to keep trying to help Gary prioritize his health, rest, and work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary's restless behavior and avoidance of work discussions. When confronted gently, Gary says his situation is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworking because of hospital pressures and that Gary may be struggling more than he initially admitted.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restlessness, avoidance, and vague confession make Ethan suspect that Gary's overwork is tied to deeper personal or emotional problems, not just professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is hiding something painful or complicated and does not want to burden others, but may be willing to open up with support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, compassionate, and alert to deeper issues.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to gently confront Gary, encourage him to open up, and offer nonjudgmental support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Gary agrees when Ethan suggests prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary's overwork has deeper causes, but he does not yet know the full reasons behind Gary's behavior.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan learns that Gary's overwork stems from new departmental pressures plus personal challenges, and that Gary is receptive to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes he understands Gary's situation better and that Gary can improve if he prioritizes tasks, delegates, and organizes his schedule.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to help Gary find a better work-life balance by assisting with prioritization, delegation, and schedule organization.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports that things are better, that he is less overwhelmed, and that he even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has started making changes and may improve with ongoing support, but he is not fully certain the progress will hold.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's reports and visible efforts show that the changes are producing real improvement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is making genuine progress toward a healthier balance and benefits from continued encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to continue checking in, offering support, and encouraging Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels much more in control now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving and still benefits from check-ins, though he may need less active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Seeing Gary manage on his own, Ethan concludes that Gary has achieved a stable healthier balance and no longer needs active support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is capable of maintaining his work-life balance independently, while knowing Ethan remains available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied, happy for Gary, and proud.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to step back from regular support and let Gary manage independently, while remaining available if Gary ever needs him.
